audit_events.reason: Extracted numeric capacity_mva from unit strings such as '75 MVA'.
Duplicate feeder_id (e.g. CMI-F18) kept first deterministic occurrence.
Divided feeder lengths > 1000 (entered in metres) by 1000 to obtain km.
Imputed missing feeder customers_served with same area_type median (raw preserved).
Converted max_temp_c > 50 (Fahrenheit readings) to Celsius.
Replaced negative rainfall sentinel (-999) with NaN to avoid biasing averages/correlations.
Removed identical duplicate rows across all columns.
Removed duplicate outage_id keeping most complete row.
Removed cross-channel duplicate incidents sharing (feeder_id, start_time).
Standardized feeder_id casing/hyphen/zero-padding to XXX-FNN.
Converted dd/mm/YYYY Buddhist Era dates (>= 2400) to Gregorian.
Repaired start_time typo years (2014/2042/2204) using outage_id / end_time year.
Swapped start_time and end_time where end_time < start_time.
Replaced placeholder duration_min (>= 9999: 9999/99999/14400) with NaN / group median.
Replaced duration_min entered in hours with (end_time - start_time) in minutes.
Back-calculated missing duration_min from valid timestamps.
Back-calculated missing end_time from start_time + duration_min.
Replaced impossible customers_affected > feeder.customers_served with feeder valid median (raw & capped preserved).
Replaced negative crew_arrival_min with NaN.
Flagged valid high-duration extreme events (> Q3 + 3*IQR = 664.00 min) without removing them.
